message: EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC (line 6) names this copybook itself (inventory issue self_include). Registering it would create a USES_COPYBOOK self-reference, so it was not registered and is left as an unresolved stub. The precompiler SQLCA structure (SQLCODE, SQLSTATE, ...) is not defined in this file; only SQL-STATUS-CODES is.
